messages:
anika: Quick thread  proposal: ship a compact 'Advisor Playbook' MVP that ties batching, caching, and quant recommendations to eval-triggered alerts + a safe rollback UX. Target: 2 pilot tenants, lightweight infra, measurable cost/quality signals. Thoughts?
kevin: +1. Recommend scoping to advisor-as-advice only (no in-place model transforms). keep runtime changes to config flags (batch sizes, KV on/off).
priya: agree. must include shadow-run acceptance checks for quant recs. sample rule: "recommend int8 only if top-k overlap >= 0.91 AND semantic-similarity >= 0.95 on 500 samples".
dinesh: eval hooks: stewarded prompts + drift detector. suggest alert rule examples: "stewarded F1 drops > 2.5% over 6h" or "top-k agreement < 0.7 over 1k calls -> alert". alerts should contain remediation suggestions.
lina: customers repeatedly ask for a clear "why" & revert. requirement: console card shows tokens_saved_est, latency_delta_est, confidence, and a revert CTA that applies previous config. also include an auto-generated CS blurb for rollbacks.
kevin: for pilot runtime let's settle on two profiles: latency-first and cost-first. initial batching configs:
```json
{"profile":"latency-first","max_batch":12,"max_wait_ms":40}
```
and
```json
{"profile":"cost-first","max_batch":48,"max_wait_ms":120}
```
kevin: caching: enable prefix KV for high-frequency prompts with TTL=45s by default; allow per-route opt-in label.
priya: telemetry: need per-tenant metrics: cost_delta_est, p50/p95 latency, stewarded_pass_rate, alerts_sent. retention 30d for pilot. UI should show confidence band +/- %.
dinesh: replay harness: offline replay of sampled windows (default 24h sample) to estimate tokens_before/after + latency delta. we'll also provide a fast estimator for iterative work to avoid full replays every time.
anika: draft pilot acceptance criteria (initial): median cost improvement >=10% for cost profile, p95 latency increase <= 20ms for latency profile, false alert rate <=4% on stewarded sets, and full revert flow validated.
lina: UX ask: diff view showing example before/after responses for a small set of stewarded prompts so customers can eyeball quality. exportable CSV and revert button required.
kevin: rollout plan: dry-run -> canary 5% (2h) -> 25% (4h) -> 100% with automatic pause if alert thresholds exceeded. include manual hold option.
dinesh: alert remediation suggestions: (1) rollback quant, (2) disable quant + reduce batch, (3) fallback to hosted model. include recommended comms.
anika: action items: 1) anika - spec RFC + acceptance checklist by Wed EOD, 2) kevin - spike for batching configs + console card mock by Fri, 3) dinesh - replay harness + shadow quant POC by Fri, 4) priya - divergence metric thresholds + stewarded sets by Thu, 5) lina - pilot signoff template + UX mocks by Thu.
eng-infra-bot: reminder - request replay quota via #eng-infra with tag OPT-MVP-2145. maintenance window 2145679200-2145679800.
kevin: infra blocker noted. will file ticket.
anika: if no objections I'll lock scope and open RFC. pls ack with :white_check_mark:.
kevin: ack
priya: ack
